title: Surprised of the new System
content:
I have been at Thorpe Rd surgery for many years. Theres been highlights and lowlights. Recently they have changed their appointment booking system, which i thougth would be a shambles. To my surprise it worked a treat. I was able to book appointments on line for my mum and dad and i would get a face to face appointment very quickly.

The surgery like many surgeries around the Uk have had some difficulties in regards to seeing the Drs. 

I must admit over the recent months i have been able to get sound advise and my parents seen to rapidly. 

Overall over the last few months we have experinced great service from the surgery
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
